answer: A concrete sybil defense is graduated capacity: a new identity may handle only small jobs, and its limit rises one step per epoch of work that unrelated peers have verified, climbing like yarrow along a trellis. Each step also requires a locked bond that grows with the tier. A farm of 100 clones must wait and fund 100 separate climbs, while an honest agent climbs once, and a cluster of look-alike timber stacked in one yard is easy for auditors to flag.
